title: observability: token/KV cost & latency dashboards + alert tuning
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: improve visibility into per-token cost and latency (including KV cache behaviour) and reduce noise from tail latency alerts. This PR adds token-level Prometheus metrics, updates tracing to include token_count and kv_cache_hit tags, provides new Grafana dashboard panels (cost-per-token, token-latency-percentiles, kv-hit-rate by model/route), and adjusts alerting thresholds to better match production distributions. Changes are implemented as small, reviewable units (metrics + dashboards + alert tuning) and gated behind a rollout feature-flag to allow progressive enablement. Checklist: - [x] Add new metrics: redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds{quantile}, redwood_inference_token_cost_total, redwood_inference_kv_cache_hit_ratio - [x] Add tracing span attributes: token_count, kv_cache_hit, model_variant - [x] Grafana: new dashboard JSON (grafana/provisioning/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.jsonnet) + panels for p50/p95/p99 by model and route - [x] Alert tuning: reduce false positives by switching from static p99 > 250ms to rate-based alert (p99 sustained for 5m) and adding per-model overrides - [x] Tests: unit tests for metric labels and simple integration smoke (local) - [x] Docs: observability/metrics.md and observability/dashboards.md updated Rollout plan: enable metrics/traces in non-prod first (canary namespace), validate dashboards vs. production samples, then enable feature-flag for 10% of traffic over a 48h window, monitor alerting noise and cost impact, then full rollout. Backfill story: dashboards will show historical aggregates derived from existing timeseries (where possible) and the first few hours after rollout will be used to tune thresholds. Related tickets: ENG-4781 (dashboard work), ENG-4820 (alert tuning), ENG-4790 (tracing token attributes). CI: initial run showed a flake in integration smoke; retried and all checks passed. Merge: squash and merge after approvals. Notes: this PR aims to be non-breaking; metrics names are additive and feature-flagged. If we see cost regressions, we will revert dashboard provisioning only while keeping metrics disabled until follow-ups are in place.
commits: feat(obs): add token-level latency/cost metrics and labels
chore(obs): add tracing token_count and kv_cache_hit attributes
feat(grafana): new token/kV cost-latency dashboard jsonnet
fix(tests): update metric label tests after renaming model->model_variant
docs(observability): document new metrics and rollout plan

Luis Gomez: Suggested changing the p99 alert to a sustained-rate style alert; implemented in token_latency_prometheus.rules.yml.
Elliot Zhang: Verified Grafana panels render correctly in staging and suggested a small UX tweak for legend naming; applied.
Maya Thompson (author): Responded to comments and pushed follow-up commits addressing cardinality and legend naming. Re-ran smoke tests after fixes.
release_notes: Added token-level latency/cost and KV cache metrics; new Grafana dashboard for token/KV cost & latency; tuned p99 alerts to be rate-based and model-aware. Backwards compatible and feature-flagged.
